request.query: compare natural power with real power using logarithmic inequality

items.name: Real.pow_le_iff_le_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (x ^ n ≤ y ↔ ↑n * Real.log x ≤ Real.log y)

items.name: Real.pow_le_of_le_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ n

items.name: Real.pow_lt_iff_lt_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (x ^ n < y ↔ ↑n * Real.log x < Real.log y)

items.name: Real.zpow_le_iff_le_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℤ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (x ^ n ≤ y ↔ ↑n * Real.log x ≤ Real.log y)

items.name: Real.le_pow_iff_log_le
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (x ≤ y ^ n ↔ Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y)
